title: Anchoring & graceful-degrade: pinning heuristics and canary cadence (personal notes)
content:
Purpose: quick personal log of anchoring/pinning heuristics and an early canary cadence I want to try for model flips and runtime rollouts. Not formal — iterative checklist + open questions.

Summary notes:
- Goal: minimize user-visible regressions while allowing fast rollouts. Anchor (pin) small stable cohorts, allow warmup, then gradually move baseline traffic.
- Key levers: per-tenant pin, global warm cohorts, grace-degrade policy (soft-fallback to smaller model or cached responses), timeout-based circuit breaker.

Proposed cadence (first-pass):
1) Shadow for 2h, sample 0.5% traffic for quality metrics (no latency impact).
2) Warm cohort 5% for 30m (seed cache, KV warmup).
3) Pin 2% per region (sustained 1h) while monitoring tokens/latency/error spikes.
4) If stable -> 10% steady-state for 2h, then double every hour (10 -> 20 -> 40) with signal gates.

Signal gates (immediate stop/rollback triggers):
- 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute increase over baseline OR > 3x relative in 5m window.
- Median latency increase > 25% AND p95 > 2x baseline.
- Quality regressions: BLEU/ROUGE-style evals on production prompt set: failure if > 8% drop in safety/accuracy score.
- Cost spike: per-token cost > 2x expected for 10m.

Pinning heuristics:
- Prefer long-tail, low-SLA tenants for initial pin (non-critical clients).
- Use tenant affinity: choose tenants with historically stable traffic and good signal density.
- Stagger pins across regions and SDK versions (if SDK flip required).
- Always keep a canary shadow lane with full KV cache enabled to detect hidden failures.

Actions & quick commands:
- Before pin: run `scripts/check-baseline.sh` (sanity), verify `deploy-metrics` dashboard pinned.
- Warm cache: `curl -X POST /admin/warm?cohort=canary` (ops-only).
- Emergency rollback: `make flip BACK_TO=previous` + `./scripts/unpin-tenants --all`.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to quantify "quality regression" for chat-style flows? Need a compact production prompt set + hallucination detector (follow up with Research).
- Can we automate per-tenant automatic unpin if traffic variability > X? (ask SRE if circuit-breaker integration exists).
- Validate grace-degrade fallback correctness for streaming responses (edge cases where partial streams may be served).

Telemetry to watch during rollout:
- tokens/s, 95th latency, error budget burn, model-run GPU utilization, KV cache hit ratio, small-sample human eval queue (10 prompts every 10m).

Notes from recent runs:
- 2026-02-22 test: warm cohort reduced p95 by 15% after cache warm; however, a tenant with aggressive retries tripled 5xx during ramp. Need tenant-level retry throttles.

Quick reference (for myself):
- Slack alert channel: #infra-canaries
- Runbook: confluence.redwood.ai/ops/canary-runbook (draft)
- Jira epic for automation: INF-842

End of notes. Keeping this light — will refine into a reproducible checklist and share with Leila for feedback.
